requirement.title: Passenger Management & Cabin Selection
requirement.description:
DescriptionAs a customer,
I want to configure passengers and cabin preferences,
so that pricing and availability can be calculated correctly.
DetailsPassenger categories shall include:
Adult (12+ Years)

Child (2-11 Years)

Infant (Below 2 Years)

Infant With Seat (Below 2 Years)

Customer shall be able to increase or decrease passenger counts.

Passenger summary shall update dynamically.

Customer shall be able to select:
Economy

Business

First

Additional RequirementsEconomy shall be selected by default.

Only one cabin class can be selected at a time.

Passenger validations shall be evaluated before search execution.

User StoryAs a customer, when booking flights, I want to configure passengers and cabin preferences so that search results accurately reflect my travel requirements.
ContextPassenger configuration directly impacts fare calculation, availability, taxes, and airline operational rules.
Acceptance CriteriaMinimum one Adult passenger must be present.

Maximum occupied seats allowed per booking shall be 9.

Occupied seats shall include:
Adults

Children

Infants With Seat

Infant count must not exceed Adult count.

One Adult can accompany only one Infant.

Search must not proceed if:
Adult count is zero.

Infant count exceeds Adult count.

Total occupied seats exceed nine.

Customer must be able to select Economy, Business, or First cabin.

Economy must be selected by default.

requirement.title: Flight Search & Journey Planning
requirement.description:
DescriptionAs a customer,
I want to search for flights using Round Trip, One-Way, Multi-City, and Open-Jaw journey types,
so that I can discover available flights based on my travel requirements and proceed with booking.
DetailsFlight Search widget shall be available on the homepage and booking landing pages.

Customer shall be able to search flights using:
Round Trip

One Way

Multi-City

Round Trip shall be selected by default.

Search widget shall contain:
Origin

Destination

Travel Date(s)

Guests & Cabin

Promo Code (Optional)

Search Button

Airport search shall support:
Airport Code

Airport Name

City Name

System shall display:
Airport suggestions

Popular destinations

Nearby airports

Nearby airport recommendations shall be configurable by country.

Origin and Destination airports must be different.

Only active airports shall be available for booking.

Search widget shall support desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Additional RequirementsAirport suggestions shall load dynamically while typing.

Popular destinations shall be displayed when no search criteria is entered.

Nearby airport recommendations shall be configurable through CMS/business configuration.

Search widget shall retain selected values until user modifies them.

Search components shall meet accessibility standards.

User StoriesStory 1As a customer, when I start planning a trip, I want to search and select departure and destination airports so that I can define my travel route.
Story 2As a customer, when searching for flights, I want airport suggestions and nearby airport recommendations so that I can easily find suitable travel options.
ContextFlight Search is the primary entry point of the booking journey. Customers must be able to search flights across supported journey types while adhering to airline routing and airport validation rules.
Acceptance CriteriaFlight Search widget must support Round Trip, One-Way, and Multi-City journeys.

Round Trip must be selected by default.

Origin airport must be mandatory.

Destination airport must be mandatory.

Origin and Destination airports must not be identical.

Airport search must support Airport Code, Airport Name, and City Name.

Popular destinations must be displayed when applicable.

Nearby airport suggestions must be configurable by country.

Only active airports must be selectable.

Search widget must be responsive across supported devices.
